title: Hero-Swap Harem Skills
author: Dwjliel
description:
Sexy skills for EIGHT(9?) sexy ladies as heroes!!

Submod to New Lord Hero Swap 9.0 <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3810275955> <<<<< Replacement Requirement for Lords of the End Times.

IF you have an old version that has skill names/descriptions for REPANSE please DM me or post!!

-Placeholder versions of Repanse skills included in 1.8.0

-
New mod recommendation (18 Sept 26) Slaanesh Expedition <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3801669633>. Looks like it'll appeal to fans of the themes of this mod.

I like to collect Legendary Lady Lords, via the many mods that let you confederate them into your faction.

-
Option 1 <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3034462109>-- Option 2 <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2854819509> -- Option 3 <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3644437727> -- Option 4 <https://www.loverslab.com/files/file/36630-slaanesh-expanded-corruption-confederation/>

Then I use Lord Hero Swap <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3810275955> to make them heroes, so I can have my harem in a single army.

Often though, their skills are USELESS for your faction, as they benefit troops you don't have.

That's where THIS mod comes in clutch.

It ensures not a single skill point you spend is wasted, and the buffs are always useable by the player regardless of faction.

It covers 8 characters. Alarielle, Elspeth von Drakken, Morathi, Miao Ying, Repanse De Lyonnesse, Tsarina Katarin, The Fay Enchantress, and The Sisters of Twilight.

They each get a bonus skill line (8 points) that SIMULATES them being corrupted and coming around to being Harem members.

There's a lot of flavour text that should tie-in to the buff, not just random power.

They also all have a corruption node to balance/offset that mechanic no matter your faction.

Additionally, I have EXHAUSTIVELY gone through their skill trees and any vanilla skills they had that offered no generic (only 1 faction) bonus, now offer at least 1 benefit/reason to spend that skill point (including innate traits), for all 49 skill points.

The only exception are skills that require 3 points in a previous section, but offer four options, I guarantee that 3 required options WILL have a benefit, the 4th may still be vanilla.

Oh and hero Alarielle has Greater Arcane Conduit - as she really should have in vanilla.

BALANCE:

Powerful but thematically so, nothing game-breaking (maybe Miao Ying...) some skills even have negatives! But the girls will add-up if you have them all in one army.

ANCILLARIES & Quest Items.

Purps will now work no matter the faction! As do all their mounts.

Remember some quests spawn at the start of the turn after you hit the appropriate level.

Banners are useless when characters become heroes.

(X)_Hero_Swap_Harem.7z Is the MAIN file.

(X)_Hero!Swap_HaremXtra.7z is a small optional sub-mod, that adds "whore" bullet-points to unit cards. Additionally, it also gives whorish names to Miao, Morathi, Alarielle, and Katrina. Best enabled after u "heroise" your 1st lady.

中文 Chinese translation kindly provided by 柠檬薄荷 <https://www.loverslab.com/profile/11526897-%E6%9F%A0%E6%AA%AC%E8%96%84%E8%8D%B7/> named (X)_Hero_Swap_Harem_cn.7z
